notes: Circuit follows the image: 5V -> rail(+) -> button side 1 (column 4); button side 2 (column 6) -> pin 2 and via 10k pull-down to GND rail.
Pushbutton legs straddle the centre gap in columns 4 and 6; the two legs in the same column are one side (1.l/1.r in column 4, 2.l/2.r in column 6).
Catalogue bank 't' (rows a-e) is taken as the half nearest the power rails the wires use, so rails are named tp/tn; exact rail hole numbers are arbitrary (each rail is one strip).
Resistor right lead assumed in column 9 (same column as the black wire to the GND rail); exact rows are approximate from the image.
The built-in LED on pin 13 is on the Uno; no external LED is used by this tutorial.
